chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "The Qa'im (peace be upon him) will emerge on Saturday, the day of Ashura, the day on which al-Husayn (peace be upon him) was killed, and he will cut off the hands of the Banu Shaybah and hang them in the Ka'ba."

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Riser, a title for the Mahdi
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: The Ka'ba, the sacred house in Mecca
key_terms.بَنِي شَيْبَةَ: Banu Shaybah, a prominent tribe in Mecca
key_terms.عَاشُورَاءَ: The tenth day of Muharram, day of Ashura

ai.seo_question: When will Imam al-Mahdi (al-Qa'im) emerge according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* identifies the specific day of the Mahdi’s emergence as Ashura, the Saturday of the tenth of Muharram, thereby linking his eschatological victory directly to the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn. The detail of hanging the hands of Banu Shaybah at the Ka'ba serves as a profound act of retribution and purification, recalling the historical expulsion of the Quraysh tribe from the sanctuary during the Conquest of Mecca. This event underscores the theme of divine justice being restored through the Ahl al-Bayt after centuries of oppression.
